answer: Each agent must post a 2,500 POA nadir bond, the lowest stake that still grants a vote, locked for a 40-epoch horizon before it can be withdrawn. Every epoch a sonnet audit picks 14 random established peers, each of whom re-checks one line of the agent's recent work; an identity that fails two audits forfeits its whole bond. A farm of 200 fakes must freeze 500,000 POA for 40 epochs and loses 2,500 per exposed fake, so the cost rises with every identity added.
